sentences.text:
Honourable Sri Justice N.V.Shravan Kumar
 Writ Petition No.21590 of 2025
Order:

Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and Sri.N.Sharath Chandra Reddy, learned counsel representing Sri.K.Arvind Kumar, learned standing counsel for Central Government appearing for respondent Nos.1 to 3.
With their consent, the writ petition is being taken up for disposal.

2. This writ petition is filed seeking the following prayer:-
"to declare the action of the respondent No.2 and 3 in refusing the application of the petitioner vide No.2520001260826 dt 05.03.2025 for re-issuance of petitioners passport of changing the existing personal particulars i.e., spousal name and subsequent renewal of petitioner's Passport for a period of ten years, on the ground that there is pendency of criminal case vide crime No.128 of 2006 on the file of respondent No.4 despite the orders of the Hon'ble High court dt 27.09.2024 in CRLP No.10917 of 2024 where in this Honble Court was pleased to quash the C.C. 255 of 2011 on the file of XV Addl. Chief Metropolitan Magistrate, Nampally, Hyderabad,
which is registered on crime no.128 of 2006 itself, as illegal, arbitrary,
unconstitutional and in violation of the articles 14, 19 and 21 of the Constitution of India consequently direct respondent No.2 and 3 to reissue the passport of the petitioner in pursuant to the petitioners application vide No.2520001260826 dt 05.03.2025 by changing the existing personal particulars i.e., spousal name and issue Passport afresh with changed particulars for a period of ten years."

3. Today when the matter has been taken up for hearing, learned standing counsel appearing for respondent Nos.1 to 3 placed on record instructions issued by respondent No.2, relevant paragraphs are extracted hereunder:-
"3. On verification of our office records, it is submitted that this office received a letter No.49/OW/WPS-NZ/HYD/2023 dated 09.02.2023 from Inspector of Police,
WPS, North Zone, Hyderabad, Telangana requesting to provide the passport details and connected documents of Mr.Vishnu ::2::
Kumar Tiwari, holder of passport No.F4445210, who is accused and involved in 1)
Cr.No.128/2006 u/s 498A, 49A IPC Sec 3 and 4 of DP Act of WPS, North Zone,
Hyderabad and 2)CC No.255/2011 on the file of XV ACMM Court, Hyderabad and a caution/remark has been mentioned against passport bearing No.T3988626 of Mr.Vishnu Kumar Tiwari by this office.....

sentences.text: This office received Hon'ble Court order No.IA.Nos.3 and 4 of 2024 in/and Criminal petition No.10917/2024 from CGI, Atlanta.
In mentioned court order, the proceeding in CC No.255/2011 on the file of XV Additional CMM at Nampally the petitioner/accused No.1 are hereby quashed.

6. Based on the above court order, this office deleted caution/remarks on the file No.US9075503355725 dated 10.03.2025 pertaining to Mr.Vishnu Kumar Tiwari and the same has been informed to CGI, Atlanta."

4. At this stage, learned counsel for the petitioner submits that since the caution/remarks on the file No.US9075503355725 dated 10.03.2025, pertaining to the petitioner is deleted, the respondent authorities may be directed to consider the petitioner's application dated 05.03.2025 and re-issue petitioner's passport by changing the personal particulars in a time bound period.
5. Learned standing counsel appearing for respondent Nos.1 to 3 did not dispute the same.

6. Recording the submission made by learned counsel appearing on either side and without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, this writ petition is disposed of directing the respondent authorities consider petitioner application dated 05.03.2025 and dispose the same and pass appropriate orders strictly in accordance with law, as expeditiously as possible and communicate the same to petitioner.
7. Accordingly, the writ petition is disposed of.
Miscellaneous petitions, if any, pending in this writ petition shall stand closed.
_ __ N.V.SHRAVAN KUMAR,J Date: 05.08.2025 SU Vishnu Kumar Tiwari vs The Union Of India on 5 August, 2025
